title: Pre-school's outdoor hut is back
body: The Lenches Pre-school has its woodland hut back in action and has thanked everyone involved in the project. The restored hut gives the children a versatile space for outdoor learning, complete with nature charts for spotting birds and wildlife. Via The Lenches Community Facebook group.

image.alt: The Lenches Pre-school's restored eight-sided wooden hut among autumn trees, with nature charts on its back wall
